title: Corrective fix for B-5e3ce3ef: Shared Feature Review
description:
Blocked reason: MealPlanDetailView.swift:175 — `deletePlan()` calls `parentURL.startAccessingSecurityScopedResource()` where `parentURL = url.deletingLastPathComponent()` (the plans/ subfolder). Should be `folderURL.startAccessingSecurityScopedResource()`. MealPlanDetailView.swift:155 — `renamePlan()` has the same error on the same local variable. Both operations will silently fail on real devices with file providers. A corrective developer bead targeting MealPlanDetailView.swift is required before merge.

Remaining work: Two HIGH bugs in MealPlanDetailView require a corrective bead: (1) deletePlan() must change `parentURL.startAccessingSecurityScopedResource()` → `folderURL.startAccessingSecurityScopedResource()` (line 175); (2) renamePlan() must change `parentURL.startAccessingSecurityScopedResource()` → `folderURL.startAccessingSecurityScopedResource()` (line 155). One LOW test-quality fix: ShoppingListDetailViewTests compact-mode header height constant should be 18 (matching ShoppingListDetailView.swift:257) not 24.
acceptance_criteria: Implement the minimum fix required to unblock B-5e3ce3ef.
Update tests/docs as needed for the corrective change.
Leave a handoff summary that states how the parent bead can be retried.

handoff_summary.completed: renamePlan() now calls folderURL.startAccessingSecurityScopedResource()/stopAccessingSecurityScopedResource(). deletePlan() now calls folderURL.startAccessingSecurityScopedResource()/stopAccessingSecurityScopedResource() (unused parentURL local variable removed). ShoppingListDetailViewTests compact-mode header height constant corrected from 24 to 18, test function renamed accordingly.
handoff_summary.remaining: None — all items from the bead description are addressed.
handoff_summary.risks: None identified. Changes are minimal one-line variable substitutions touching only the two named functions. No architecture changes.
handoff_summary.next_action: Route to tester agent to run the test suite and validate the corrective fix before retrying the parent bead B-5e3ce3ef review.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: No conflicts — changes are confined to MealPlanDetailView.swift (two-line fix) and ShoppingListDetailViewTests.swift (constant + function rename). No overlap with other in-flight beads.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Used the existing folderURL view property (already used correctly in createShoppingList() and persistPlan()) rather than introducing any new variable. Removed the now-unused parentURL local variable in deletePlan() to keep the function clean.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: The ShoppingListDetailViewTests compact-header test now correctly mirrors ShoppingListDetailView.swift:257. No new tests were required for the MealPlanDetailView fix — the corrective change is a direct variable substitution with no behavioral branching to cover beyond what the tester suite already exercises.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: Syntax-only parse check performed (swiftc -parse). Full compile requires the Xcode project; SourceKit reported expected module-not-found errors that resolve under xcodebuild.

conflict_risks: No conflicts — changes are confined to MealPlanDetailView.swift (two-line fix) and ShoppingListDetailViewTests.swift (constant + function rename). No overlap with other in-flight beads.

execution_history.summary: Fixed two HIGH bugs in MealPlanDetailView.swift where renamePlan() and deletePlan() called startAccessingSecurityScopedResource() on parentURL (derived from the file URL) instead of folderURL (the view's security-scoped bookmark property). Also fixed a LOW test-quality issue in ShoppingListDetailViewTests.swift where the compact-mode header height constant was 24 instead of the actual 18 used in ShoppingListDetailView.swift:257.
